interface.defaultPrompt: Use Nolane Video Command Center as the front door. interface.longDescription: Private video-production orchestrator with 31 internal skills, 37 core specialist plugins and two separate historical routes: a footage-led cinematic documentary route and an opt-in H2 Squire vector military-history route. Includes recorded-sound-first direction, resource-library search, camera/motion planning, rights-aware audio use and evidence-gated full audiovisual QA. Specialist plugins require explicit host activation; no hidden plugin-to-plugin invocation is claimed. Protects the parallel asset-library workstream.
